title: Pullback compositor and open-mate normalization of ordinary realization
statement: For the original specified ordinaryPullComparison and ordinaryOpenComparison isomorphisms, the normalized pullback-composition and open-extension-composition equations OrdinaryPullComposition and OrdinaryOpenComposition both hold. This statement contains no cartesian beta or clopen section projection.

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 03DI and 09AE for open adjunctions, 0F7B for the intrinsic clopen construction. This normalization is an agent-formulated consequence.

proof.text: For exact additive functors F,G,H and e:H≅F⋙G, cancel the exact-single hom comparisons in mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_comp_hom_app_singleFunctor to obtain the inverse-single composition equation. The constant-tower comparison satisfies its compositor equation componentwise. Naturality of the single comparison past the constant comparison combines these equations into constantSingle_comp for the specified ordinaryConstantSingleComparison. This is a proved generic calculation, not a new assumed normalization.

Use the proved generic paste_comp calculation: expand the pasted comparison, move the realization equality transports by naturality, cancel the middle transport with its inverse, and move the constant/single comparison past moduleEvalG by naturality. Apply ordinaryModuleEvalG_comp and constantSingle_comp. The resulting outer transports are exactly those in ordinaryPullComparison, giving OrdinaryPullComposition with its original isomorphisms.

Take the vertical composite of the inverse ordinary open comparisons, and compare it to the inverse composite-open comparison after whiskering by the inverse open compositors. Apply mateEquiv_hcomp and ordinaryOpen_mate. The conjugates of moduleJComp.inv and StrictTower.jComp.inv are the inverse pullback compositors by conjugateEquiv_leftAdjointCompIso_inv. The pullback equation from the previous step, after cancellation of invertible factors, gives equality of these mates. Injectivity gives equality of the inverse open-composition isomorphisms; Iso.ext_inv and inversion give OrdinaryOpenComposition.
